name: Geyser
description:
Looking for a true Game of Thrones roleplay & factions experience where your choices shape history? Ice & Fire is a massive, immersive world with a 10-year legacy, custom features, and a thriving community—and we are looking for new Houses, Sellswords, and Nobles to claim the Iron Throne!

⚔️ CORE FEATURES:

Fully Crossplay: Play seamlessly on PC (Java or Bedrock), Xbox, PlayStation, iOS, and Android!

A Song of Ice & Fire Lore: Pledge your allegiance to iconic Houses like Stark, Lannister, Targaryen, or forge your own destiny.

Custom Items & Warfare: Raise powerful pets, engage in strategic siege warfare, and participate in massive server-wide narrative events.

Economy & Intrigue: Grow your wealth, or take on a large array of PVE activities, including over 100 Unique Quests!

🎮 HOW TO JOIN RIGHT NOW:

Java IP: iceandfire.net

Bedrock IP: iceandfire.net

Bedrock Port: 21476

Discord: https://discord.gg/mYAPQbsSSD (Join to choose your House!)
